reshared_post.author_headline: Secure Platform Architect at Aegis Power Systems, Inc.
reshared_post.reshared_text: There should be a rule for software engineers. if you haven't spent a full day or more trying to determine why your code isn't compiling/working only to find it's a one line or one character change, then you cannot use any AI assisted development tools. actually, just turn off all intellisense
